description: Only DO-178B Level A certifiable (SEAL 1) C/C++ libraries are used with safety-critical code.
name: jsf_certified_libraries_only

description: Every deviation record documents the rationale and the required approval(s).
name: jsf_deviation_record_maintained

description: Dead code — executable code or data not traceable to a system or software requirement — is not present.
name: jsf_no_dead_code

description: Safety-critical (SEAL 1/2) software makes provision for run-time checking (defensive programming).
name: jsf_runtime_checking_provided

description: Each deviation from a 'shall' rule is documented in the file that contains the deviation.
name: jsf_shall_deviation_documented

description: Compliance with 'shall' rules is verified (automatically or manually) before code is committed.
name: jsf_shall_rules_verified

description: Any violation of a 'shall' rule is covered by an approved deviation.
name: jsf_shall_violation_deviated

description: Breaking a 'shall' or 'will' (mandatory) rule is approved by BOTH the software engineering lead and the software product manager.
name: jsf_shall_will_deviation_dual_approved

description: Breaking a 'should' (advisory) rule is approved by the software engineering lead.
name: jsf_should_deviation_approved

description: Source is checked against the JSF++ ruleset by static analysis before it is committed.
name: jsf_static_analysis_before_commit

description: Any violation of a 'will' rule is covered by an approved deviation.
name: jsf_will_violation_deviated
